card.name: Unit word after a dose amount
card.fires_on: The unit or count word right after a dose number, such as mg, units, inhalations or factor, where a frequency like once daily, weekly or every week is expected next.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: The unit mg or units follows a number in a dosing instruction.
modes.example: start tadalafil at 20<< mg>> once daily.

modes.label: Inhalation counts
modes.description: The word inhalation(s) follows a number in an inhaler dosing line.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of STRIVERDI RESPIMAT is two inhal<<ations>> once-daily at the same time of

modes.label: Rate factor
modes.description: The word factor follows a number in a non-drug rate statement.
modes.example: increasing exponentially at a rate of a<< factor>> of 100 every decade.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a frequency word next, such as daily, weekly, yearly or annually.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a dose amount where the text says how often to take it.
